title: Radial Entertainment launches "Paranormal Chronicles" FAST channel ahead of Halloween - Señal News
excerpt: The company expands its streaming portfolio with a new 24/7 free ad-supported channel focused on supernatural investigations, mystery true crime, and documented hauntings across major digital platforms.
content:
Radial Entertainment has officially launched "Paranormal Chronicles," a premium FAST channel dedicated to paranormal investigations, documented hauntings, unexplained phenomena, and mystery-driven true crime. Arriving in time for the Halloween viewing season, the 24/7 channel is available for free across platforms including Google TV Freeplay, LG Channels, Plex, The Roku Channel, DISH TV, Bonusview, and Sling Freestream, with an expansion to Amazon Prime Video scheduled for later this month.

Debuting with a catalog of over 500 hours of broadcast-quality content, "Paranormal Chronicles" offers a round-the-clock destination for ghost stories, supernatural mysteries, and upcoming Radial Originals. The channel's rollout features a marathon of the unscripted series "A Haunting," alongside key titles such as "Death Walker," "Ghost Stories," "Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction," "Monsters & Mysteries in America," and episodic content from digital creators "Sam and Colby." Additional seasons and new titles are slated for addition later in 2026.

Brendon Thomas, Chief Revenue Officer of Radial Entertainment, said: “Paranormal and unexplained mystery programming continues to drive passionate, repeat viewing across streaming platforms. Paranormal Chronicles gives fans a thrilling, always-on destination with a deep launch lineup that will continue to grow as we add more titles - including Radial Originals.”

The strategic move expands Radial Entertainment's growing FAST and AVOD footprint by tapping into a genre with high seasonal engagement and consistent year-round viewership. The channel's programming mix combines established library franchises, personality-driven content, and mystery series structured for continuous streaming and marathon viewing.
